fields.stats: Prospero: Mind, Allure, Resolve, Vitality, Essence, Luck, 1 to 30 with 10 an ordinary adult. Null where another file is the authority.
fields.tier: the NPC's weight on the shared ladder
fields.secret: hidden from the player character; an importer should mark it hidden
fields.eras: campaign eras the NPC appears in; missing means post-reform only for this file

cast.name: Mistress Sara
cast.role: Founder and hidden hand of the Brotherhood of Man
cast.look: A calm woman in pale fabrics, with steady hands and teeth that are a little too perfect; in lamplight they have an opal sheen.
cast.voice: Quiet, unhurried, precise. Asks questions she already knows the answers to. Praise from her sounds like classification.
wants: To be queen of the Eternal Dragons
fears: The New Gods noticing her too soon
Clever mortals who keep their heads
cast.secret: She is the Eternal White Dragon Saradrosk.

relationships.cybelia: Knew her secret and kept it, in the Brotherhood era. Sara considered her a clever mouse.

cast.name: Melton Ilvar
cast.role: Fifth-generation patriarch of the Mossrun Expedition
cast.look: A wealthy merchant in his prime, always about to be ill.
cast.voice: Genial, generous, forgettable on purpose.
fears: An heir who comes home early
cast.secret: He is the Eternal Red Dragon Zaraxas, and has been every Ilvar patriarch since he murdered Aldon Ilvar. Each time, he marries, adopts an orphaned baby, lets the wife 'die in childbirth', sends the child away to be educated, and is dying when the child returns.

cast.name: Edith Ilvar
cast.role: Ilvar heir, called home from her schooling because her father is dying
cast.voice: Educated, dry, a little too observant for her own good.
wants: To see her father before he dies
To know why every Ilvar wife died
fears: Being married off before she understands the business
cast.secret: She has found a portrait of her great-great-grandfather, and it is her father's face.

relationships.melton-ilvar: her father, as far as she knows

cast.look: Twenty-two, ink on her cuffs, her mother's portrait in a locket, and the Ilvar habit of standing very still when she is listening.

cast.name: Illeniana Zehara, "Lady Zee"
cast.role: Owner of A Pocketful of Zzz's
cast.look: An elven woman of indeterminate age, always dressed a season ahead of fashion, rings on every finger.
cast.voice: Warm, delighted, quick to bargain, slow to let go of a thing she wants.
wants: Relics that survived the Reformation, above all from the Old Gods
A good story with every object
cast.secret: She is the Eternal Copper Dragon Zeharyth. She vanishes for a generation or two whenever whispers start, and opens again in a new city. Her shop was in Trein before Asania.

cast.name: Master Grimm
cast.role: Master of the workshop that makes most of the world's enchanted arms
cast.look: A dwarf a little too big for a dwarf, with stark green hair, emerald eyes, and ivy worked into his clothes and armor. Looks more like a druid than a smith.
cast.voice: Gruff, exacting, says the price before the hello.
wants: The best work in the world to come from his shop
To know where it all goes
cast.secret: He is the Eternal Green Dragon Forgrimmorithal.

cast.name: Lady Hewlight, the Axe-Widow
cast.role: A dwarven matron who turns up in history whenever the Ley is in danger
cast.voice: Fond, nosy, delighted by human drama; neutral to the bone.
wants: The Ley healthy and open to those the world deems worthy
cast.secret: She is the Eternal Crystal Dragon Ryndhallach.
cast.origin_note: Her current home is not in the source.

cast.name: Reeve Aldous Marr
cast.role: Reeve of Kingswood
cast.secret: In debt to the Cyrel Timber Guild; has secretly sold the Heartwood cutting rights.

cast.name: Hesk Varro
cast.role: Mill foreman, Kingswood
cast.note: His brother was killed by an elf arrow.

cast.name: Mother Ilse Rook
cast.role: Keeper of the Shrine of Tidum, Kingswood
cast.secret: Knows what lies under the Heartwood's Ley convergence.

cast.name: Corin Ashby
cast.role: Keeper of the Felled Oak, fence and informer

cast.name: Mag Hollin
cast.role: Keeper of Mother Mag's at Low Ford, fence

cast.name: Sereth of the Ford
cast.role: Half-elf herb seller, 142 years old
cast.secret: A Brynwyr warden's eyes in town.

cast.name: Sergeant Bram Tolley
cast.role: Sergeant of the Cyrel watch, Kingswood

cast.name: Lord-Commander Odo Fennick
cast.role: Commander of Bastion
cast.voice: Short sentences, no adjectives. Counts everything: men, arrows, days.
fears: The day Unguruk stops raiding and starts besieging
cast.secret: Has been quietly letting some deserters go, because hanging them empties his walls faster.
cast.look: Sixty, grey stubble, one shoulder higher than the other from an old spear wound, and a ledger always under his arm.

cast.name: Murga Hollowtooth
cast.role: War-chief of the Unguruk tribe
cast.voice: Laughs at threats, remembers insults for twenty years, speaks Cyrellian better than she lets on.
fears: Becoming the war-chief who sold the passes to a devil, as one did in Aveus's day
cast.secret: A polite stranger in clean robes has visited her fire twice. She has not said no yet.
cast.look: A tall orc in a coat of Cyrel officers' buttons, with a gap where her left canine was knocked out in a challenge she won anyway.

cast.name: Captain Nettle Skabb
cast.role: Goblin trader-captain of Kadragar
cast.voice: Haggles in three languages at once, swears by the Erlking's hounds.
fears: The Wild Hunt, which she has heard once
cast.look: A goblin in a sea-stained admiral's coat three sizes too big, with brass rings in both ears and a compass she cannot read.

cast.name: Under-Registrar Piers Ockley
cast.role: Trein licensing clerk and Brotherhood cell member
cast.voice: Quotes slogans when nervous. Ink on his hands, zeal that has not met consequences.
wants: To be noticed by Mistress Sara
fears: That the old Brotherhood ledgers are true
cast.secret: Keeps a copy of the cell's member list in his boot.
cast.look: Thin, young, too-bright eyes, a Brotherhood flower pin he has polished smooth.

cast.name: Court Arcanist Benedek Sorrel
cast.role: War mage of the Asanian court
cast.voice: Elegant, impatient with anyone slower, talks about the war like a chess problem.
wants: A crystal stockpile big enough to end the Cyrel war
cast.secret: Has been buying Brotherhood-made valves through a Trein middleman.
cast.look: Silver-haired, beautifully dressed, crystal chips sewn into his cuffs like buttons.

cast.name: Councillor Agathe Fumbridge
cast.role: Gnome engineer on the Wrenspire Council
cast.voice: Thinks out loud, draws on whatever is nearest, distrusts anything that glows.
wants: An airship route over the Badlands
fears: That magic is simply better and she is wasting her life
cast.look: A gnome with goggles pushed into her hair, burn scars on both forearms and pencil behind each ear.

cast.name: Captain Jory Keel
cast.role: Captain of the Dreadfall Corsairs' flagship
cast.voice: Soft-spoken, courteous, and the cruellest person on the Gulf.
cast.look: Small, neat, clean-shaven, with a reader's spectacles and a hook-bladed knife he never takes off.

cast.name: Abbot Tetsu Imura
cast.role: Abbot of the Benzaiten Monastery
cast.voice: Answers questions with tasks. Laughs at the right moments and only then.
fears: Being asked to choose a side
cast.secret: Knows that the dragon of Petrakyra is Old Mother Yllen, and keeps a shrine to Nicana, who trained here as a girl, that he pretends is a garden.
cast.look: Old, bald, barefoot, with knuckles like walnuts and a laugh that arrives a moment late.

cast.name: Vault-Mistress Sabine Orrell
cast.role: Keeper of one Obirykan state's crystal vault
cast.voice: Speaks in weights and percentages; wears her rank in carats at her throat.
cast.secret: Her vault is short, and she knows which of her deputies took it.
cast.look: Tall, severe, a necklace of graded crystals at her throat that marks her rank to the carat.

cast.name: Sees-Twice
cast.role: Lizardfolk elder of Ota'at, keeper of the market's challenges
cast.voice: Blunt to the point of rudeness; respects only what has been tested.
cast.look: A grey-scaled lizardfolk elder missing one eye, wearing a necklace of the teeth of challengers.

cast.name: Mudfather Haldric Brannoch
cast.role: High priest of the Cult of Vymnommyth
cast.voice: Gentle and paternal, and talks about poison the way other priests talk about grace.
wants: The swamp to reach Dun Aldun
cast.look: A white-bearded dwarf with mud-black hands to the elbow and a kind, tired face.

cast.name: Thane Gudrun Stoneheart
cast.role: Head of the Stoneheart Clan, ruler of the Dwarven Empire
cast.look: The clan's blue eyes, grey braids, a winter coat she never takes off indoors.
cast.voice: Fair, slow, final. Every sentence sounds like a ruling.
cast.secret: Suspects Master Grimm is not a dwarf. Has decided not to know.

cast.name: Old Mother Yllen
cast.role: An elder of Petrakyra
cast.look: An elven woman so old her skin has gone the color of birch bark, with silver eyes and a walking stick she does not need.
cast.voice: Soft, motherly, absolutely immovable. Calls everyone 'child', including kings.
wants: Petrakyra left out of the world
The brood-fire back, if it can be had without war
fears: Her elves learning what she is
cast.secret: She is Yllevantharyx the Silver, the ninth Eternal Dragon.

relationships.tetsu-imura: the only outsider she writes to

cast.name: Wendel Ashcombe
cast.role: Junior Brotherhood clerk in Trein
cast.look: Barely old enough to shave, ink-stained hands, eyes too bright.
cast.voice: Quotes slogans when frightened: 'Magic for mortals. No more gods.'
wants: To believe the Brotherhood is good
fears: Finding out what the ledgers mean
cast.secret: Nicana let him live, and he has started copying the allocation ledgers for someone he hopes will use them well.
cast.origin_note: The unnamed clerk in Nicana's story.

cast.name: Alderman Royce Fallow
cast.role: Brotherhood patron in Trein
cast.look: Fat, beringed, beaming, smelling of expensive wine.
cast.voice: Talks about self-determination with his mouth full.
wants: His allocation numbers to look good
cast.secret: His ledger marks a healers' quarter for cuts as 'low productivity'. Girione robbed his storeroom.
cast.origin_note: The unnamed patron in Girione's story.

cast.name: Liaison Humbert Lisle
cast.role: Brotherhood liaison in Convila
cast.look: Thin, perfumed, with a ledger-clerk's stoop.
cast.voice: Smiles while he threatens. 'See, the system works.'
cast.origin_note: The unnamed liaison in Witarr's story.

cast.name: Dorruk Long-Speech
cast.role: War-chief of Unguruk who bargained with a devil
cast.look: A heavy orc in a bronze-studded harness, fond of a high seat by the fire.
cast.voice: Speeches. Always speeches, about strength he talks as if he invented.
wants: Power he does not have to fight for
cast.secret: He agreed to open the passes when the time came, in exchange for borrowed power. Aveus denounced him in front of the tribe.
cast.origin_note: The unnamed war-chief in Aveus's story.

cast.name: Mister Ambry
cast.role: A devil in clean robes, offering deals
cast.look: A pleasant man in robes too clean for the Badlands, with soft hands and a sure smile. The air around him feels tight, like the world wrapped in wire.
cast.voice: Warm, complimentary, unhurried. Calls refusal 'bravery' to make it sound foolish.
cast.secret: A servant of Mammon. Aveus crushed one of its bodies in the 3120s; it came back. In the Post-Reform era it is the polite stranger at Murga Hollowtooth's fire.
cast.origin_note: The unnamed devil in Aveus's story, carried forward.

cast.name: Castellan Ivo Brandt
cast.role: Commander of Adlmyr
cast.look: Broad, sunburned, with a beard he braids for luck before every sortie.
cast.voice: Cheerful in the way of a man who knows the odds.
wants: Reinforcements from Cyrel that never come
His son kept at Bastion, safe
cast.secret: He has been paying the Kadragar for warnings, and the payments have stopped.

cast.name: Mother Wenna Callow
cast.role: Priestess of Freya in Eriane
cast.look: Broad-hipped, flour on her apron, a falcon feather in her hair.
cast.voice: Warm, then suddenly fierce.
wants: Her goddess to answer as she did when Wenna was young
fears: That she is praying to an empty sky
cast.secret: Her healings have started working only near the lake, where the Ley runs a little stronger. She has told no one.

cast.name: Magister Cuthbert Hale
cast.role: Trein scholar who resents temples and dragons
cast.look: Long-faced, shabby velvet, pamphlets in every pocket.
cast.voice: Gives lectures at dinner. Funny, bitter and convincing.
wants: Magic for mortals, without priests or dragons in the way
cast.secret: Mistress Sara funds his salon. Two centuries on, the salon's heirs will found the Brotherhood.
